metadata.statistical_discipline: Five frozen E checkpoints are independent units; F is a secondary control (not pooled). Transition-level counts are descriptive; inference is seed-level paired.

classification.rule_note: candidate/commit-specific requires net>0 in >=4/5 seeds AND (net - matched-orthogonal net)>0 in >=4/5 seeds AND success-regression not worse than the matched control (+0.02). O-A/B/C/D by which side is specific. Bars are declared conventions, not tuned cutoffs.
